title: fix(plugin-security, objectql, spec): owner, queue and field-write 403s carry a localized userMessage; forged audit columns on create are reported
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-support-ai"} -->
_Requested by **Yibo Wang** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwB?thread=cmsg_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwB2b88nPMbwESqYGT6PsNVo4)_

Fixes #32278

Clause-②: yes (widening)
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：负责人（owner）改派、替他人建记录、清空负责人、队列改动、字段无权编辑这五类 403 现在带 `userMessage`（中英日西四语，来自运算消息目录）；伪造的 `created_by` 在创建时会以 `droppedFields` 上报，不再静默改写。
- 为什么改：控制台对没有 `userMessage` 的 403 一律弹通用"无权限"提示，用户看不出被拒的是什么；伪造 `organization_id` 有上报而伪造 `created_by` 没有，口径不一致。
- 风险与回滚：只新增字段，`code`、状态码、`message` 字节不变，存储结果不变；回滚即撤此 PR。字段名只在调用者可读且有标签时才出现，否则不点名字段。
- 先看：`packages/plugins/plugin-security/src/security-plugin-authz-middleware.ts`（五处拒绝与 `fieldEditDenialMessage`）、`packages/objectql/src/engine-top-level.ts`（`handBackWithheldInsertReadonly` 的上报条件）、`packages/spec/src/system/operation-message.ts`（新目录键）。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/plugin-security exec vitest run src/owner-queue-field-write-user-message.test.ts`，预期 23 项全绿。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes

**`userMessage` on five refusal classes (plugin-security authz middleware).** Each refusal keeps its `code` (`PERMISSION_DENIED`), status (403) and developer `message` byte for byte, and gains a `userMessage` rendered at throw time through the middleware's existing catalog reader (`userFacingDenialMessage` → `renderOperationMessage`, the `errors.<key>` override address, the caller's `context.locale`). No second resolver. `mapDataError` already relays a thrown `userMessage` to the REST body.

| Class | Site | Catalog key |
|---|---|---|
| changing the owner | `denyOwnerWrite` on update with a non-empty owner; `denyOwnershipChange(CLAIM_REFUSAL)` | `record_owner_change_denied` |
| creating a record for someone else | `denyOwnerWrite` on insert | `record_owner_assign_denied` |
| disowning | `denyOwnerWrite` on update with an empty owner; `denyOwnershipChange(RELEASE_REFUSAL)` | `record_owner_remove_denied` |
| queue write | `denyQueueWrite` (insert into a queue the caller is not in, move between queues) | `record_queue_change_denied` |
| field write | step 2.5 throw | `field_edit_denied` (`{{fields}}`) / `field_edit_denied_opaque` |

Measured correction to the order's helper mapping: `denyOwnerWrite` on update covers both a transfer and a disown, and `denyOwnershipChange` covers a refused claim (an owner change) and a refused release (a disown, the record has no home queue). So the key is chosen per situation, not per helper; the five classes are as ruled. The guest refusals (`denyGuestOwnerWrite`, `denyGuestQueueWrite`) are not among the five and are unchanged.

**No grant names, no API names.** None of the six sentences names `allowTransfer`, `modifyAllRecords` or a field API name (pinned over all four locales).

**Field-write naming, per #7414 / #7451.** The sentence names the refused fields by LABEL only when every refused field has one (the deployment's translated label for the caller's locale, else the declared label; never the API name as the last rung, and a declared label equal to the API name counts as none) and the caller reads it (`computeQueryGuardFieldPerms`, the read guard the masker uses; a field withheld from the caller is not named to them, even by label). One field that fails either test makes the sentence opaque, so a partial list never reads as the whole one. The object-level refusal is untouched: it stays the nameless catalog `permission_denied` and gains no `userMessage`.

**Forged audit columns on create are reported (objectql).** Measured on `origin/main` 351c22c9 with the real ingress (`ObjectQLPlugin` + the audit binder): a forged `created_by` is withheld from `beforeInsert`, the binder stamps the session user, the hand-back sees a hook-written key and keeps the stamp, and the static strip spares it, so nothing reported the lost value. A forged `organization_id` in the same request was reported. `handBackWithheldInsertReadonly` now pushes an `AUDIT_PROVENANCE_FIELDS` key (`created_at`, `created_by`, `updated_at`, `updated_by`) that it does not hand back, when the stored value differs from the caller's, and `insert` reports it in the existing `{ object, fields, reason: 'readonly' }` event (the union through `onFieldsDropped` and the per-row `droppedFields` of `insertMany`). A value equal to the stamp adds no row. The stored row does not change, and `strictReadonlyWrites` still stores the stamp rather than refusing (the report is not a refusal). Only the audit provenance keys: any other read-only key an app's hook assigns stays the hook's write and is not reported, as `engine-insert-readonly-hook-input.test.ts` and `engine-per-row-dropped-fields.test.ts` pin (my first, generic version reported every hook-written key and turned those two pins red; the narrowing restores them unchanged). Only the existing `'readonly'` reason is used.

**`owning_business_unit_id`.** No stamp exists (ADR-0117 D2's stamping middleware has not landed), so the static strip already takes a forged value and reports it. Measured on main 351c22c9 in the same rig before this change: `droppedFields: [{fields:['owning_business_unit_id'], reason:'readonly'}]`, and on the live showcase at this head the same. No code change for it; it is pinned beside the change. The phase-1 report's reading of "no row" for it did not reproduce.

**Spec.** Six catalog keys in `BUILTIN_OPERATION_MESSAGES` (en, zh-CN, ja-JP, es-ES), rows in the catalog's situation table and a per-site placeholder note. No schema, export or type change.

## Tests

- `packages/plugins/plugin-security/src/owner-queue-field-write-user-message.test.ts` (23): each class in en and zh-CN carries `BUILTIN_OPERATION_MESSAGES[locale][key]` with `code`, status and the old `message` asserted byte for byte; no sentence names a grant or an API name; field write names the declared label (en), the translated labels in list form (zh-CN), and no field when one has no label or is unreadable; CONTROL: object-level 403 has no `userMessage`; `mapDataError` carries `userMessage` on a PATCH transfer and a POST field write, and none on the object-level CONTROL.
- `packages/objectql/src/engine-insert-hook-stamped-readonly-report.test.ts` (9): forged `created_by` stored as the stamp and reported; CONTROL equal-to-stamp adds no row; forged `created_at` reported; one event per reason beside `organization_id`; partial-mode batch carries it on the sending row only; `strictReadonlyWrites` still stores the stamp; `preserveAudit` keeps the caller's value and reports nothing; forged `owning_business_unit_id` reported; CONTROL no send, no row.

### Ablations

Each through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` on a committed tree (head 7e9da534), restored by the script; `git status --porcelain` empty afterwards and both files green again (23/23, 9/9).

- (a) the queue refusal's `userMessage` replaced with `''` (anchor `userFacingDenialMessage(ctx, 'record_queue_change_denied', opCtx.context?.locale),`): exit 1, **4 failed | 19 passed** — both queue cases (move between queues, create into a queue the caller is not in) in en and zh-CN.
- (b) the "differs" condition replaced with `true` (anchor `(!present || !Object.is(target[key], callerValue))`): exit 1, **2 failed | 7 passed** — `CONTROL: created_by sent equal to the stamp adds no row` and the partial-mode batch (its equal-value row gained a row).

### Live wire check (showcase dev boot, this branch)

Probed at e0034ebb (before the audit-key narrowing in 7e9da534, which does not change any reading below). A member invited into the seeded org; `Accept-Language: zh-CN` where marked. `error` is the unchanged developer message.

| Request | Status | `userMessage` / `droppedFields` |
|---|---|---|
| PATCH `showcase_private_note/:id {owner_id: admin}` | 403 `PERMISSION_DENIED` | en: "You do not have permission to change the owner of this record. …"; zh-CN: 「您无权更改这条记录的负责人，如需改派请联系管理员。」 |
| PATCH `… {owner_id: null}` (zh-CN) | 403 | 「您无权清除这条记录的负责人，如需更换负责人请联系管理员。」 |
| POST `showcase_private_note {owner_id: admin}` (zh-CN) | 403 | 「您无权创建负责人为他人的记录，请将负责人留空或设为自己，或联系管理员。」 |
| POST `… {created_by: admin}` | 201 | `[{fields:['created_by'], reason:'readonly'}]` |
| POST `… {created_by: self}` | 201 | none |
| POST `… {owning_business_unit_id: 'bu_forged'}` | 201 | `[{fields:['owning_business_unit_id'], reason:'readonly'}]` (as on main) |
| POST `… {organization_id: 'org_forged'}` | 201 | `[{fields:['organization_id'], reason:'readonly'}]` (as on main) |
| PATCH `showcase_project/:id {budget}` (contributor, en) | 403 | "You do not have permission to edit “Budget”. …" |
| PATCH `showcase_project/:id {budget, spent}` (zh-CN) | 403 | 「您无权编辑「预算」、「已花费」，请撤销这些修改后重试，或联系管理员。」 |
| PATCH `sys_user/:self {role}` (zh-CN / en) | 403 | opaque: 「您无权编辑所修改的部分字段，…」 / "…one or more of the fields you changed…" |
| CONTROL: PATCH `showcase_project/:id` without object edit (zh-CN) | 403 | no `userMessage`; `error` is the catalog `permission_denied` sentence, unchanged |

The queue class was not probed live; it is pinned by the four unit cases, and it reaches the wire through the same `mapDataError` relay the transfer and field-write pins exercise.

## Acceptance notes

- The field-write sentence uses the read guard (`computeQueryGuardFieldPerms`), which also treats a partially masked field as unreadable. That is stricter than the metadata plane (which serves a masked field) and names nothing in that case: the conservative side.
- On the live showcase, a member's `PATCH sys_user/:self {role}` answers the opaque sentence: `role` (label "Platform Role") is not readable for a member, so it is not named.
- A sent `null` for `owning_business_unit_id` is reported by the pre-existing static strip, as any read-only key is; that is unchanged here.

## Verification

- Suites at 7e9da534 (through `scripts/pm/os-verify-lock.sh`): objectql 585 files / 12086 tests, plugin-security 259 / 6260 (45 skipped), rest 400 / 7682 (332 skipped), spec 834 / 26595, all exit 0; `typecheck` for plugin-security, objectql and spec exit 0.
- After merging `origin/main` (69301483, which also touched `engine-insert.ts` in an unrelated region; merged clean): rebuilt the closure, objectql 12129 tests and plugin-security 6260 exit 0; the three typechecks exit 0; `check-changeset-no-major --base origin/main`, `check:engine-double-contract`, `check:authorable-surface`, `check:api-surface`, `check:i18n`, `check:error-status-conformance` exit 0. No `authorable-surface` or `json-schema` file moves: the spec diff is catalog strings only.
- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands` at the merged head derives 104 commands; all 104 run with exit 0 (96 at 7e9da534; the other 8 come from the ledger file under `scripts/`, run at the merged head); `--ran`: 104 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN. Two needed a fix on the way: `check:engine-double-contract` asked for the new test's double in the ledger (`--write`, committed); `check-plugin-teardown-shape --self-test` needed its pinned fixture commit fetched (shallow clone), then exit 0.
- The roster gates marked ⛔ for these paths, run as well: `check:meta-url-spelling`, `check:changeset-fixed`, `check:error-code-casing`, `check:filter-alias-parity`, `check:authz-resolver`, exit 0.
- `eslint` on the six touched source and test files: exit 0.
